ModMetaData.name: Colonist Autonomy
ModMetaData.author: Krzysztof Zawisła
ModMetaData.description: Colonists ask a local decision model what to do next; Cloudflare Clef (Flash Q8 by default, Q4 optional) is the model the mod installs. The mod can install llama.cpp and the model from its settings on Windows, Linux and macOS. Requires Harmony; third-party licenses are included in About/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
